patch.description: Full-time Remote/Lahore role for an engineer with at least two years of experience. Own client features across APIs and interfaces using React, Node.js and TypeScript. PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL and Git form part of the stack. The work includes several concurrent projects and close product ownership. Apply by email with a CV, role name in the subject and a short introduction. The hiring process later includes a technical call and a compensated 4-8 hour trial.
patch.draft:
Hi TBox Solutionz team,

I'm applying for the Full-Stack Engineer (React + Node.js) role. I build production products with React, TypeScript, Node.js and Express, and have four years of TypeScript experience, hands-on GraphQL experience and production experience with PostgreSQL.

At Tututor.ai / EduNova, I lead engineering across eight connected education products and work directly with the founder. My work includes a shared Express/MongoDB backend, real-time messaging, billing and mobile delivery. I've also built analytics integrations at Illume and reusable client interfaces at Danzee Tech.

Your focus on owning features from API to UI is a good match for how I work. I'm based in Pakistan, available immediately, and interested in the remote full-time role. I'd be happy to discuss the products and how I could contribute.

My tailored CV is attached. You can see my work here:
https://itsubaidullahomer.com
https://github.com/itsubaidullahomer

Best regards,
Ubaidullah Omer
